sam (DevEx): Quick heads-up — opened docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 to clarify egress/SNI proxy behavior for Private/VPC installs. Need a quick tech pass around HSM port forwarding + air-gapped notes. cc @noah @jen :wave:

anna (Docs): On it. I'll scan for ambiguous wording. Main question: should we recommend 'tls_sni' or 'sni_passthrough' as the config key? The current draft uses both in different places — confusing.

noah (Security): Definitely use 'sni_passthrough' — calling it 'tls_sni' implies we terminate TLS. Also we should include a short note about client cert pinning for KMS in case of middleboxes. I'll paste an example fingerprint line.

mike (Eng-Platform): Small nit — the diagram link images/sni-diagram.png 404s in the branch. I pushed a commit that swaps that link to /assets/diagrams/sni-proxy.svg. Also cleaned up the YAML example for the proxy container.

anna (Docs): thanks. I left inline comments and added a short nftables example for the common air-gapped pattern (only allowing SNI passthrough to the KMS endpoint):
```
# allow outbound SNI passthrough to kms.example.internal:443
table inet filter add chain OUTBOUND { type filter hook output priority 0; }
add rule inet filter OUTBOUND ip daddr 10.0.5.0/24 tcp dport 443 ct state new counter accept
# drop everything else to enforce egress policy
add rule inet filter OUTBOUND counter drop
```

jen (SRE): Confirmed this on a sealed dev VPC (no internet egress). With the above rules + proxy set to sni_passthrough the HSM attestation call to kms.example.internal:443 completed. Test checklist I ran (pasted):
- install on isolated VPC
- apply nftables rules
- verify HSM -> KMS TLS handshake with sni_passthrough
- confirm no DNS leaks to public resolver
All green except image link which Mike fixed.

noah (Security): Added a one-liner about KMS client TLS fingerprint to the PR description: `fingerprint: "sha256/AAAAAAAA..."` so ops can verify cert pin on bootstrap. We should also recommend logging the socket destinations during bootstrap for troubleshooting (short snippet added).

docs-bot: PR #482 updated — 3 commits, 5 files changed. Checks: markdown-lint OK, linkcheck: 1 warning (now fixed). :white_check_mark:

sam (DevEx): Awesome, thanks everyone. Anna — can you squash the tiny fix commits into one before merge? If QA passes in the next hour I'll merge and schedule a docs-prod deploy. :thumbsup:
